firstPlayerRule: The player who was last on a balcony goes first.
clarifications: Play then proceeds clockwise. In a full game, play one round per player so each player starts and finishes the turn order once.

sources.title: Council of Verona — English rulebook
sources.location: Setup; Three Or More Players; Turn Sequence; Variant Play

internalEvidence: Rendered PDF page 2 (printed page 2) of the original Crash Games English rulebook preserved by 1jour-1jeu and checked text on pages 3, 5 and 11. Setup names the most recent balcony visitor; the turn sequence specifies clockwise play, and Full Game says each player is first and last once.
